# CTMT Builds Ltd.

> CTMT Builds Ltd. is a framing contractor in British Columbia, Canada, run by Curtis Mountain. It frames new homes, multi-family and townhome projects, commercial wood buildings, roofs and trusses, additions and structural renovations. Phone and text: (250) 857-0881. Email: ctmtbuildsltd@gmail.com.

## Services
- [New Home Framing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#new-homes): Complete wood framing for custom homes and production builds, from floor system to roof.
- [Multi-Family & Townhomes](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#multi-family): Repeatable, accurate framing for townhomes, duplexes and multi-unit buildings.
- [Commercial Wood Framing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#commercial): Structural wood framing for commercial and mixed-use buildings on demanding schedules.
- [Roofs, Trusses & Sheathing](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#roofs): Stick-framed roofs, truss installation and roof and wall sheathing.
- [Additions & Structural Renovations](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#renovations): Additions, garages, removed walls and structural changes tied cleanly into the existing house.
- [Interior & Exterior Walls](https://northcreststudio.github.io/ctmt-builds/services.html#walls): Wall framing, basement development, blocking and backing done right the first time.
